items.title: What Could CME Group (CME) Gain From Its New U.S. Zinc Futures?
items.summary: CME Group (NasdaqGS:CME) recorded the first trades in its new U.S. Zinc Futures contracts, with participation from Glencore and Trafigura. The contracts expand CME Group's regional industrial metals offering aimed at U.S. price risk management and transparency. The launch targets participants across the U.S. zinc supply chain, including producers, traders and end users. items.title: PCE Inflation Data Sets High Bar For Warsh's Jackson Hole Speech
items.summary: The Federal Reserve's primary inflation gauge, the core PCE price index, showed no relief from price pressures ahead of Chairman Kevin Warsh's Friday speech at the annual Jackson Hole monetary policy symposium.
